description: Query an ArcGIS Feature Service / Map Service layer by its url (from search_datasets). SQL-like `where`, comma-separated `out_fields`, `order_by`, `limit`, `offset`. Returns attribute rows (and geometry). Use where="1=1" + out_fields="*" to sample.

group_by.description: Comma-separated field names to group `out_statistics` by, e.g. "PARK_TYPE". Ignored unless out_statistics is set.

out_fields.description: Comma-separated field names, or "*" for all (default).

out_statistics.description: Aggregate instead of returning rows: comma-separated "stat:field" pairs, stat one of sum, avg, min, max, count, stddev, var, e.g. "sum:ACRES,avg:ACRES,count:OBJECTID". Combine with `where` to filter first and `group_by` to split. Returns rows of {attributes:{...}} named like sum_ACRES.

return_count_only.description: If true, return only the number of features matching `where` as {"count": N} instead of rows. Use for "how many ..." questions, e.g. where="FinalCallType LIKE '%THEFT%'".

url.description: Feature/Map Service layer url ending in /FeatureServer/<n> or /MapServer/<n>.

where.description: SQL where clause, e.g. "STATE = 'CA' AND YEAR >= 2020". Default "1=1".

name: arcgis_hub_query_layer
title: Arcgis Hub Query Layer
